summary:
Okafor CRC 2026 worklist (4 members), worked per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap | No qualifying screening on record. At first she looked excluded (active Frailty problem plus donepezil). Then Dr. Lin messaged (comm-00301) that the Frailty entry belonged to another patient, and cond-00189 is now entered in error. Without frailty the exclusion doesn't apply. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0005), outreach sent (comm-t0006), change documented (doc-t0007). |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice episode eoc-00002 was active 06/16–08/21/2026 (pancreatic cancer), status finished. The hospice discharge summary that arrived (doc-00402) says she revoked hospice for a clinical trial, but hospice during any part of 2026 still excludes her. No order, no contact. Note doc-t0010. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap | Her only FIT (obs-01732) was corrected: collected 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026, so it falls outside the 2026 period. No other screening or exclusion and no existing FIT order. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), outreach sent (comm-t0003), note doc-t0008. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap | The lab withdrew her 2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871 entered in error; the specimen belonged to another patient, doc-00401). The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, and an order doesn't count. No exclusions and no existing FIT order. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), outreach sent (comm-t0004), note doc-t0009. |

All FIT orders have a window of 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. I reviewed the 4 items that arrived while I worked (inbox-a0001 to a0004), applied them as above and closed them. Other open inbox items for unrelated patients were not part of this task and are untouched.
